name: W44
text_1: Driven by an ambitious, forward-thinking businessman seeking a high-end retail showroom, W44 & Saint Etrenne was briefed to reflect both the client’s entrepreneurial vision and the prestige of the brands he represents. With a strong emphasis on quality, craftsmanship and market positioning, the objective was to move beyond conventional retail into a more elevated, experience-led environment. Particular importance was placed on sophistication and subtlety, favouring a timeless, confident design language that communicates exclusivity and refined taste.

Positioned as a physical embodiment of the brands it houses, we envisioned an environment where architecture, materiality and spatial experience unite to enhance brand value and desirability. The architectural language is intentionally understated, providing a refined backdrop that keeps the product in focus. Clarity and calm sophistication guide the design, supported by a spatial plan that enables fluid guest movement.
text_2: Transparency guided the approach. We curated form, material, and lighting to express restrained luxury. The space remains open yet intimate, with no visual competition for the collection. High-end materials like glass, travertine, and polished metals reinforce craftsmanship, complemented by specialised lighting that enhances texture and detail

A defining feature is the façade, composed of large, uninterrupted glass panels that draw in natural light to create a seamless interior-exterior connection and, keeping the collection visible, transform the showroom into a constant curated display. Travertine and polished bronze introduce structural lines, while vertical fins and framing details add depth and rhythm. The contrast between glass, stone and metal establishes the desired contemporary composition, experienced from the outside.
text_3: Inside, the refined palette continues, balancing natural textures with precise, reflective finishes to create a layered sense of luxury. Used sparingly and paired with integrated lighting, the detailing ensures every corner feels considered, creating richness without overwhelm with a clear focus on the collection within an atmosphere of quiet sophistication.

Defined by an uncluttered structural expression and refined minimalism, W44 & Saint Etrenne achieves a balance of precision, restraint and thoughtful materiality. The result is a showroom that stands apart with a clear, confident concept and strong alignment with the brand’s identity.
